name: Dahl Inference
description: Estonian-run Gonka reseller giving every new account 100M tokens free.
overview: Dahl Inference resells capacity from the Gonka decentralised GPU network through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at inference.dahl.global/v1, and its homepage states the offer plainly: "First 100 million tokens free". It is a one-time promotional grant rather than a monthly reset, and the terms let Dahl withdraw free access at any time. The catalogue is the Gonka set — MiniMax M2.7, DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM-5.3 Flash and Qwen3.8 Flash — with no per-request cap published; the operator is FROMZERO OÜ in Estonia.
free_access: 100M free tokens on signup — the largest one-time grant found
No card needed to claim the key
Runs on decentralised Gonka GPU capacity
notes: One-time grant, no reset, and the terms reserve the right to end it. Claims a 99% saving against corporate per-token averages, which is a pricing comparison rather than a quality claim.
